title: Gen General Programs
language: TRS-80 Pocket Computer PC-1 / Sharp PC-121x BASIC
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: GEN general mathematics collection
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. PC-121x header and 168 recorded checksums; ordered lines; terminators; actual F0 EOF; exact length; byte-identical left/right TAP

versions.startupSource:
1 "="USING : INPUT ">>>";Z$: GOTO Z$
    2 END 
   10 "BOOL"CLEAR : INPUT "NO.INPUTS?",Z: USING "####"
   20 GOSUB 100: FOR W=1 TO Z: PAUSE "INPUT#";W;"=";A(W): NEXT W
   30 X=0<X: PRINT "X=";X:Y=Z+1
   40 Y=Y-1: IF Y=0 GOTO 1
   50 A(Y)=0=A(Y): IF A(Y) GOTO 20
   60 GOTO 40
  100 D=0=A:E=0=B:F=0=C
  110 X=DEC+DBF+AEF+ABC: RETURN 
  210 "CO"INPUT Y,X:C=Y: IF Y-X>X LET X=Y-X
  220 FOR Z=1 TO X:C=C/Z: IF Y-Z>Y-X LET C=CY-CZ
